HOW WE WORK

A clear process.
A shared vision.

01 / CONNECT

Tell us your idea.

Message us with your reference, timeline and what you want to create. We agree on the scope and quote.

02 / CREATE

We shoot. We shape.

We plan and film your production, or work with your existing footage to build the edit.

03 / DELIVER

Review. Refine. Release.

Share your feedback, approve the final cut and receive files ready for your chosen platforms.

Video services: your questions

What kinds of videos do you edit?+

We edit films, music videos, trailers, microdrama promos, reels, YouTube videos, podcasts and wedding films. Explore the editing portfolio for examples, then share your footage and references to discuss your project.

Can you edit my existing footage?+

Yes. Share your raw footage, audio, brand assets and references. We’ll discuss what can be created from your material before the edit begins.

How much will my project cost?+

Every project has a different scope. Send the footage length, desired output, editing style and deadline for a tailored quote. Revision rounds and deliverables are agreed before starting.

Can I book ongoing content support?+

Yes. We can discuss a recurring scope for reels, YouTube, podcasts, social media content or campaign support based on your publishing schedule.
